name: VFR Only
description: For VFR-only pilots. Conservative cloud and visibility thresholds, focuses on visual flight conditions. Disables IFR-specific advisories.

name: IFR Conservative
description: For IFR-rated pilots preferring conservative assessments. Uses worst-case aggregation across models. All advisories enabled including IFR feasibility with tighter ceiling thresholds.

name: IFR FIKI
description: For FIKI-equipped IFR aircraft. Tolerant digest guidance and majority aggregation for balanced assessments. Icing is graded for the aircraft you fly: mark it FIKI on the aircraft form.
